text: SUBJECT: Q3 budget review notes|CONTENT: Hi Dana, attached are the revised Q3 budget notes from Tuesday's meeting. Could you forward them to the finance team by end of day Thursday? Let me know if the travel line item still needs a second look.

SUBJECT: Invoice 4471 from Brightline Supplies|CONTENT: Hello Marcus, the invoice for the March office supply order came in for $1,284.50. Please route it to accounts payable for payment by Friday, April 12. Thanks, Priya

SUBJECT: Team lunch Thursday|CONTENT: Hi all, we're booking a table atOla's Kitchen for Thursday at 12:30. Reply to this thread by Wednesday so I can give the restaurant an accurate headcount. Vegetarian options are available.

SUBJECT: Updated onboarding checklist|CONTENT: Hi Javier, I updated the onboarding checklist in the shared drive with the new laptop request steps. Please review rows 14 through 22 and add any missing IT contacts before Monday. Thank you.

SUBJECT: Confirm conference room booking|CONTENT: Hi Lena, could you confirm that you have Conference Room B reserved for the client call on May 8 from 2:00 to 3:30? The calendar shows a conflict with another team. Let me know either way.

SUBJECT: Vendor contract renewal|CONTENT: Hi Tom, the renewal for our cloud storage contract with Veltrix Systems is due on June 30. Please review the attached redline and send your comments to legal at legal@harlowgroup.example by June 14.

SUBJECT: Quarterly all-hands agenda|CONTENT: Team, here's the draft agenda for the quarterly all-hands on Friday. Please add your updates to the slide deck before Wednesday noon. Slides should be no more than three per team.

SUBJECT: Expense report reminder|CONTENT: Hi everyone, a quick reminder that expense reports for February need to be submitted in the portal by the 5th. Attach receipts for any item over $25. Thanks for staying on top of this.

SUBJECT: Sales data for region West|CONTENT: Hey Ruth, I pulled the sales numbers for the West region into the tracker spreadsheet. Can you check the totals in column F against your records and flag any mismatch by Tuesday?

SUBJECT: Holiday schedule|CONTENT: Hi folks, the office will be closed on Monday, May 27 for Memorial Day. Please plan any deliveries or client deadlines around that date. Reply if you have questions about coverage.

SUBJECT: Payroll correction|CONTENT: Hello Kenji, payroll flagged a missing overtime entry for the week of March 3. Could you submit a timesheet correction through the HR portal by March 15 so it's included in the next run? Thanks.

SUBJECT: Design mockups v2|CONTENT: Hi Sofia, version two of the homepage mockups is in the design folder. Please leave comments directly in the file rather than by email. We're aiming to finalize by the 20th.

SUBJECT: Warehouse inventory count|CONTENT: Team, the annual inventory count at the Dayton warehouse starts Monday, September 9. Please make sure your bins are labeled and that the counting sheets are printed before 7 a.m. Thanks, Greg

SUBJECT: Welcome to the team|CONTENT: Hi Amara, welcome aboard! Your first day is Monday at 9:00 at the Lincoln Street office. Please bring a government ID and reply to confirm you received the parking details.

SUBJECT: Forwarding the client brief|CONTENT: Hi Owen, I'm forwarding the client brief from Northwind Logistics. Please review it and add your estimate to the project sheet by Thursday so we can prepare the proposal.

SUBJECT: Training registration|CONTENT: Hi Chen, the spring safety training is open for registration. Sign up through the learning portal by April 30. Sessions are two hours and there are seats available on both Tuesday and Thursday.

SUBJECT: Printer maintenance|CONTENT: Hi all, the third-floor printer will be offline Wednesday afternoon for scheduled maintenance. Please send urgent print jobs to the second-floor unit instead. It should be back by 4 p.m.

SUBJECT: Project timeline update|CONTENT: Hi Nadia, I moved the testing phase to April 18 to give QA more time. Please update your milestones in the project tracker and let me know if this affects your dependencies.

SUBJECT: Parking permit renewal|CONTENT: Hello, parking permits for the Riverside garage expire on June 1. Renewal forms are on the facilities page. Please submit yours with the $40 fee by May 20 to avoid a gap in access.

SUBJECT: Client meeting notes|CONTENT: Hi Beth, here are my notes from this morning's call with Alder Partners. Could you review the action items and confirm which ones you'll own? I'll put the final list in the shared doc.

SUBJECT: Purchase order approval|CONTENT: Hi Raj, PO 20913 for $6,400 in lab equipment is waiting for your approval in the procurement system. Please review and approve by Wednesday so the vendor can ship on schedule.

SUBJECT: Updated phone list|CONTENT: Team, I've refreshed the department phone list in the shared folder. Please check your extension and let me know if anything is wrong. The old version can be deleted once you've confirmed.
SUBJECT: Friday coffee chat|CONTENT: Hi Mei, would you be free for a quick coffee chat this Friday around 3 p.m.? I'd like to get your input on the new intake process. Let me know what works.

SUBJECT: Fire drill schedule|CONTENT: Hi all, the building fire drill is scheduled for Thursday, October 12 at 10:15 a.m. Please follow the posted exit routes and meet at the north parking lot. No reply needed.

SUBJECT: Marketing budget spreadsheet|CONTENT: Hi Carlos, I added the Q4 marketing spend to the budget spreadsheet. Could you update the paid social column with actuals from the ad platform by Monday morning?

SUBJECT: Software license renewal|CONTENT: Hello Ingrid, our license for the design suite renews on August 1 for 25 seats. Please confirm the seat count with your team and reply by July 20 so procurement can process the order.

SUBJECT: Candidate interview schedule|CONTENT: Hi Paul, I've scheduled interviews with the two finalists for the analyst role on Tuesday. Please confirm you can join the 10:00 and 1:30 slots and send feedback forms within 24 hours.

SUBJECT: Lab safety audit|CONTENT: Hi Dr. Okafor, the lab safety audit is scheduled for May 14. Please complete the checklist for Bay 3 and return it to facilities by May 10. Let me know if any equipment needs service.

SUBJECT: Shared drive cleanup|CONTENT: Team, we're archiving files older than two years from the shared drive next week. If you have something you still need, move it to the Active folder by Friday. Thanks for helping keep things tidy.

SUBJECT: Travel booking for Denver|CONTENT: Hi Sam, please book your flights for the Denver conference on the company travel portal. The budget cap is $650 round trip. Send me your itinerary once it's confirmed.

SUBJECT: Press release draft|CONTENT: Hi Lauren, the draft press release for the Series B announcement is attached. Please review the quotes from our CEO and reply with any changes by 3 p.m. tomorrow.

SUBJECT: Recycling program update|CONTENT: Hello all, the building recycling bins have moved to the lobby. Please bring cardboard to the loading dock on Mondays. Thank you for helping us reduce waste this quarter.

SUBJECT: Customer survey results|CONTENT: Hi Jun, the results from the March customer survey are in the report folder. Could you summarize the top three complaints for the Tuesday product review? A half-page is fine.

SUBJECT: Password policy reminder|CONTENT: Hi everyone, passwords for the finance systems must be updated by the end of the month under our standard policy. Use the self-service reset page and follow the length requirements listed there.

SUBJECT: Contract signature needed|CONTENT: Hi Hannah, the service agreement with Crestview Dental is ready for signature. Please sign the last page and send it back through DocuSign by Thursday so we can start the project on the 15th.
SUBJECT: Warehouse shift swap|CONTENT: Hi Diego, can you cover the Saturday morning shift on June 14? Jamal is out that week. Reply by Wednesday so I can update the schedule.
SUBJECT: Board deck feedback|CONTENT: Hi Rachel, I've attached the draft board deck for next month. Please review slides 4 through 9 for your division and send comments to me by Monday afternoon.

SUBJECT: Mileage reimbursement|CONTENT: Hi Ben, I noticed your mileage log for April is missing the odometer readings for two trips. Please add them to the form and resubmit by May 3 so we can process the payment.

SUBJECT: Quarterly newsletter submissions|CONTENT: Hello, we're collecting submissions for the Q2 newsletter. Send a short paragraph about your team's wins and a photo if you have one. The deadline is June 6.

SUBJECT: Vendor onboarding form|CONTENT: Hi Alicia, Halvorsen Printing has been approved as a new vendor. Please complete the onboarding form in the procurement folder and return it with their W-9 by Friday.

SUBJECT: Team offsite logistics|CONTENT: Hi all, the offsite is set for September 22 at the Lakeview Lodge. Please fill in the dietary form in the shared sheet by September 8. Carpool details will follow.

SUBJECT: Support ticket escalation|CONTENT: Hi Marcus, ticket 88342 from Oakridge Medical has been open for five days. Could you take a look today and update the customer directly? Let me know if you need help from engineering.
SUBJECT: Library book return|CONTENT: Hi Nora, the reference binder you borrowed from the library is due back on Friday. Please return it to the front desk or let me know if you need an extension.

SUBJECT: Annual review scheduling|CONTENT: Hi Greg, let's schedule your annual performance review for the week of November 11. Please propose two times that work for you and I'll send the calendar invite.

SUBJECT: Kitchen supplies restock|CONTENT: Team, we're running low on coffee filters and paper cups in the break room. I've placed an order for Thursday delivery. Let me know if you need anything else added.

SUBJECT: Grant report deadline|CONTENT: Hi Yusuf, the grant progress report for the Hanley Foundation is due March 28. Please send your section on program outcomes by March 21 so I can compile the final draft.

SUBJECT: Visitor badge request|CONTENT: Hi Olivia, our guest from Pinecrest Engineering arrives Monday at 11 a.m. Please request a visitor badge at the front desk under my name and let me know if you need the badge number.
SUBJECT: Dashboard access|CONTENT: Hi Felix, I've granted you read access to the operations dashboard. Log in with your usual credentials and let me know if the Q2 tab doesn't load for you.

SUBJECT: Field trip permission forms|CONTENT: Dear parents, the permission forms for the April science museum trip are due to the front office by April 2. Please sign and return the form with the $12 fee. Thank you.
SUBJECT: Retirement party|CONTENT: Hi all, we're celebrating Dave's 30 years with the company on Friday at 4 p.m. in the Maple Room. Please sign the card at my desk and RSVP by Wednesday.

SUBJECT: Data migration timeline|CONTENT: Hi Priyanka, the customer records migration is scheduled for the weekend of July 12. Please confirm that your team has reviewed the mapping document and flag any fields that need changes by July 5.

SUBJECT: Catering order for workshop|CONTENT: Hi Tanya, I've confirmed catering for the Thursday workshop with Fresh Table Co. for 35 people. Please check the order sheet and let me know if the count needs to change by Tuesday.

SUBJECT: Account reconciliation|CONTENT: Hi Robert, the April bank reconciliation is ready for review in the finance folder. Please check the outstanding checks list and initial the summary tab by May 9 so we can close the month.

SUBJECT: Dinner on Sunday?|CONTENT: Hi Mark, are you and Lisa free for dinner this Sunday around 6? We're thinking of trying the new Thai place on Elm Street. Let me know if that works for you, and bring the photos from your trip!

SUBJECT: Rent payment reminder|CONTENT: Hello Mrs. Patel, just a quick reminder that the March rent of $1,450 is due on the 1st. You can drop the check in the mailbox by the front door or send it through the portal. Thanks, Daniel Ortiz

SUBJECT: Soccer practice schedule|CONTENT: Hi parents, practice has moved to Thursdays at 4:30 starting next week because the field on Maple Avenue is closed for repairs. Please make sure your kids bring water bottles and shin guards. See you on the field!

SUBJECT: Grandma's birthday|CONTENT: Hey sis, Grandma turns 90 on June 12th and we're planning a small lunch at her place. Could you pick up the cake from Sweet Rose Bakery on the way over? I'll cover the cost when I see you.

SUBJECT: Invoice #4471 for website redesign|CONTENT: Dear Ms. Chen, attached is the invoice for the website redesign project totaling $3,200. Payment is due within 30 days. Please reply to confirm you received it. Best regards, Tom Briggs, Briggs Design Studio
SUBJECT: Lost umbrella|CONTENT: Hi Jen, I think I left a black umbrella in your car after the carpool last Tuesday. If you find it, could you drop it off at school on Friday? Thanks so much!

SUBJECT: Book club this month|CONTENT: Hi everyone, our book club will meet on the 18th at Priya's house. We're discussing 'The Night Garden' by Lena Hart. Please bring a snack to share and jot down two questions you'd like to talk about.

SUBJECT: Parking permit renewal|CONTENT: Dear Resident, your parking permit for Building C expires on April 30. Please renew at the front office at 210 Oak Street, Suite 4, or call 555-0142 to arrange a pickup time.

SUBJECT: Car repair estimate|CONTENT: Hi Robert, the shop finished looking at your Honda. The brake pads and rotors need replacing, and the estimate is $412. Let me know by Wednesday if you want us to go ahead. Thanks, Eastside Auto Care

SUBJECT: Weekend hike|CONTENT: Hey Kai, the weather looks great Saturday, so I'm thinking we hit the Cedar Ridge trail around 8 a.m. Can you grab sandwiches and I'll bring the water? Text me at 555-0188 if you're in.

SUBJECT: Field trip permission slip|CONTENT: Dear families, the Grade 4 trip to the science museum is on October 9th. Please sign the attached permission slip and return it to Ms. Rivera by Friday. The cost is $12 per student, payable with the slip.

SUBJECT: Thank you|CONTENT: Dear Aunt Rose, thank you so much for the sweater you sent for my birthday. It fits perfectly and I wore it to dinner last night. I hope you're doing well, and I'll call you this weekend.

SUBJECT: Garage sale this Saturday|CONTENT: Hi neighbors, we're holding a garage sale at 42 Pine Court this Saturday from 9 to 2. We have bikes, kids' toys, and a few kitchen items. Feel free to stop by and bring a friend.
SUBJECT: Meeting moved to 3pm|CONTENT: Team, the project status meeting has been moved from 2 to 3 p.m. in Conference Room B. Please update your calendars and bring your Q2 numbers. Thanks, Sara Kim

SUBJECT: Vet appointment|CONTENT: Hi Mr. Lopez, this is a reminder that Biscuit's annual checkup is scheduled for Tuesday at 10:15 a.m. at Riverside Animal Clinic. Please bring his vaccination card. Call us at 555-0175 if you need to reschedule.
SUBJECT: Carpool for Friday|CONTENT: Hi Donna, can you pick up Eli and his friend from practice on Friday? I have a late meeting downtown. I'll owe you one, and I can take them Monday instead.

SUBJECT: Gym membership change|CONTENT: Hello Jordan, your Fitness First membership has been upgraded to the family plan effective June 1. Your new monthly rate is $64. Please stop by the front desk to pick up your updated card.
SUBJECT: Recipe you asked for|CONTENT: Hi Melissa, here's the lemon chicken recipe I mentioned at lunch. I usually marinate it for two hours and bake at 375 degrees. Let me know how it turns out!

SUBJECT: Maintenance visit Thursday|CONTENT: Dear tenant, a plumber will be stopping by Unit 3B on Thursday between 9 and 11 a.m. to fix the kitchen faucet. Please make sure the sink area is clear. Thank you for your patience.

SUBJECT: Quick question about the flyer|CONTENT: Hi Ben, do you still have the PDF of the spring fundraiser flyer? I need to print copies for the library bulletin board by Monday. You can send it to me at dana.wells@example.org.

SUBJECT: Reunion planning|CONTENT: Hi class of 2008, we're planning our 15-year reunion for August 16 at the Lakeview Hall. Tickets are $35 and can be paid at the door or through the link on our page. Please RSVP by July 20.

SUBJECT: Happy anniversary|CONTENT: Dear Tom and Ann, congratulations on 25 years together! We'd love to celebrate with you on Saturday at our house. Dinner starts at 7, and we'll bring the dessert. Let us know if you need a ride.

SUBJECT: Lease renewal offer|CONTENT: Dear Mr. Nguyen, your lease at Willow Creek Apartments ends on August 31. We are offering a 12-month renewal at $1,520 per month. Please sign and return the enclosed form by July 15.
SUBJECT: Library book due|CONTENT: Hi, this is a courtesy reminder from Westside Public Library that your book 'River of Stars' is due on May 22. You can renew it online or by calling 555-0199.

SUBJECT: Sorry I missed you|CONTENT: Hey Sam, I stopped by your place but you weren't home. Could you text me when you're free this week? I have the concert tickets and want to make sure we're still on for Friday.

SUBJECT: Snow day plans|CONTENT: Mom, the school district announced a snow day for tomorrow. I'm going to sleep in and then help shovel the driveway. Can you let Grandpa know I'll come by for lunch on Wednesday instead?

SUBJECT: Team lunch order|CONTENT: Hi all, we're ordering lunch from Garden Bowl at noon on Thursday for the quarterly review. Please reply with your choice by Wednesday afternoon so I can place the order. Thanks, Priya
SUBJECT: Payment received|CONTENT: Dear Mr. Owens, we have received your payment of $89.50 for your March utility bill. Your account is now current. Thank you for choosing Lakeside Water Services.

SUBJECT: Piano lessons|CONTENT: Hi Mrs. Hall, Lily's lesson will be moved from Wednesday to Thursday at 5 p.m. this week because I'm out of town. Please let me know if that causes any problems. Thanks, Michelle

SUBJECT: Bike shop pickup|CONTENT: Hi Alex, your bike is ready for pickup at Spokes and Gears on Main Street. The new chain and tune-up came to $58. We are open until 6 p.m. weekdays and until 4 p.m. on Saturdays.

SUBJECT: Recommendation for my nephew|CONTENT: Dear Professor Hayes, my nephew Marcus is applying for the summer internship program at your lab. He is hardworking and curious, and I believe he would be a great fit. Would you be willing to speak with him briefly?

SUBJECT: Flu shot clinic|CONTENT: Dear parents, the school nurse will host a free flu shot clinic in the gym on October 3 from 8 to 11 a.m. Please return the consent form to the main office before September 28.

SUBJECT: Visiting next month|CONTENT: Hi Dad, I booked my flight for the 14th and I land at 4:20 p.m. on Friday. Could you pick me up from the airport? I'm looking forward to seeing you and the new garden.

SUBJECT: Water heater update|CONTENT: Hi Ms. Foster, the repair crew replaced the water heater in your building yesterday. Hot water should be back within two hours. If it isn't, please call the office at 555-0121.

SUBJECT: Can you cover my shift?|CONTENT: Hey Jamie, something came up and I can't work my Saturday shift at the cafe. Would you be able to swap with me for Sunday? I'll take any evening shift next week to make it up.

SUBJECT: Scholarship deadline|CONTENT: Dear Maya, this is a reminder that the Harper Community Scholarship application closes on March 15. Please upload your transcript and essay through the online portal. Good luck, and let me know if you have questions.

SUBJECT: Pool closing date|CONTENT: Hello residents, the community pool will close for the season on Labor Day at 6 p.m. Please remember to return your pool key to the management office. Thank you for a great summer!

SUBJECT: Congrats on the new job|CONTENT: Hi Erin, I just heard about the marketing position at Brightline Media. That's fantastic news! Let's grab coffee next week so you can tell me everything about it.

SUBJECT: Your order has shipped|CONTENT: Hello Mr. Ward, your order #88215 from Harbor Home Goods has shipped and should arrive by Thursday. You can track the package using the link in your account. Thanks for shopping with us.
SUBJECT: Lunch on Tuesday?|CONTENT: Hi Ruth, I'm in your part of town on Tuesday for a meeting. Are you free for lunch around noon? I'm happy to go to whichever place you like best.

SUBJECT: Community cleanup day|CONTENT: Neighbors, our street cleanup is Saturday at 9 a.m. Meet at the corner of Birch and 5th. Gloves and bags will be provided. Please bring your own water and wear closed-toe shoes.

SUBJECT: Dentist reminder|CONTENT: Hi Olivia, this is a reminder that your cleaning is scheduled for Monday at 2:30 p.m. with Dr. Lin at Bright Smile Dental. If you need to change the time, please call 555-0166 at least 24 hours in advance.

SUBJECT: Kids' birthday party|CONTENT: Hi Carla, Noah is turning seven on Saturday, and we'd love for Mia to come to his party at the trampoline park from 1 to 3 p.m. Please RSVP by Thursday so I can book enough jump passes. Thanks!

SUBJECT: Tax documents|CONTENT: Hi Greg, I finished organizing the receipts for last year's taxes. Could you send me your 1099 forms by the end of the week? I want to get everything to the accountant before the April deadline.

SUBJECT: Office closing for holiday|CONTENT: Dear staff, the office will be closed on Monday, May 27 in observance of Memorial Day. Regular hours resume Tuesday at 8 a.m. Please plan any urgent deliveries in advance.

SUBJECT: Garden plot assignment|CONTENT: Hi Frank, your garden plot at Greenfield Community Garden is now plot 14, next to the tool shed. Please pick up your key from the coordinator, Lisa, on Sunday morning. Happy planting!

SUBJECT: Concert tickets|CONTENT: Hey Nate, I got two tickets for the Saturday show at the Civic Theater. They're in row F, seats 9 and 10. Want to split the cost? It's $48 total, so you owe me $24 whenever is convenient.

SUBJECT: Heating system inspection|CONTENT: Dear homeowner, our technician will arrive on Tuesday between 8 and noon for your annual furnace inspection. Please make sure the area around the unit is accessible. Call 555-0139 with any questions.

SUBJECT: Thanks for the ride|CONTENT: Hi Ray, thanks so much for driving me to the airport this morning. I really appreciated it. I owe you a dinner, so let me know which night works for you next week.
